title: CVE-2026-87338
summary: Affected: Oracle Corporation Siebel CRM Integration Vulnerability in the Siebel CRM Integration product of Oracle Siebel CRM (component: EAI).  Supported versions that are affected are 17.0-26.9. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Siebel CRM Integration.  Successful attacks require human interaction from a person other than the attacker and while the vulnerability is in Siebel CRM Integration, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change). Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Siebel CRM Integration accessible data as well as  unauthorized update, insert or delete access to some of Siebel CRM Integration accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 6.9 (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:L/A:N).

title: CVE-2026-97045 — Check all ancestor namespace transitions when rendering raw text in html in golang.org/x/net
summary: Affected: golang.org/x/net/html In childTextNodesAreLiteral, walking up the tree previously stopped at the nearest foreign ancestor once an HTML integration point was found. However, that integration point may itself be a descendant of an element that was foster-parented into a foreign namespace (such as <mglyph> or <malignmark> fostered under <mtext>), causing a parser to resolve the subtree in a different foreign namespace upon re-parsing the rendered output. Continue walking the full ancestor chain and verify that every transition from a non-empty namespace occurs at an HTML integration point before emitting literal text.
